mutation.description: E-step responsibility gamma (Eq. 11) replaced by clip(gamma**0.35*1.4)

notes: Monotonicity of the log-posterior verified empirically over 100 EM runs on synthetic data drawn from the model of Eq. (2); converged point is a stationary point (numerical gradient ~0 and EM fixed-point residual ~0). Crowd-BT (gradient) is not monotone. This is an empirical check of an analytic guarantee, not a proof; the guarantee itself is the standard EM result (Dempster et al. 1977) and follows because the updates are exact maximizers of Q.
